reviews.text: A truly positive experience at Polly Pet Shop! Barbara is incredibly kind, helpful, and professional. You can immediately sense the passion and love she puts into her work and the great care she gives to animals. The atmosphere is welcoming, well-kept, and full of beautiful, quality products. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I've been taking my little Maltese, Rambo, to this grooming salon for years, and the service is always perfect: bath, cut, nails, ears and anal glands. They're very professional and friendly, they listen to your wishes and make them come true.
Their kindness, professionalism, and love for animals make Bob, my golden retriever, always happy to come to their place. Highly recommended.

I brought my Golden Retriever, Blanca, for a bath and ear cleaning. She's a very fearful and difficult dog to handle, so I knew she wouldn't be an easy client.

When I picked her up, they told me she was one of the most difficult dogs they've ever handled... which makes the skill, patience, and professionalism with which they treated her even more evident.

Despite the difficulties, they were kind, attentive, and very loving. Blanca left looking beautiful and spotless, but above all, calm: you could clearly see she'd been treated with respect and kindness.

It's the first time I haven't felt stressed or uncomfortable leaving her at a groomer. There's true expertise and love for animals here. Highly recommended.
